scripts.name: Copy worktree environment
scripts.command: uv run --no-project python -c "from pathlib import Path; import shutil, subprocess; root = Path(subprocess.check_output(['git', 'rev-parse', '--path-format=absolute', '--git-common-dir'], text=True).strip()).parent; files = (root / '.worktreeinclude').read_text().splitlines(); [shutil.copy2(root / name, name) for name in map(str.strip, files) if name and not name.startswith('#') and not Path(name).exists()]"
